title: Self-Repair Projects
subtitle: Troubleshooting, repairs, overhauls and modifications

fields.title: Title
fields.faultCodesHint: Press Enter or comma to add a code, e.g. P0201.
fields.specialToolsHint: One tool per line, e.g. E12 Torx
fields.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag. Existing tags are suggested.

complete.title: Complete project
complete.intro: The completion date and odometer go into the vehicle's history and update its odometer.

reopenHint: Reopening removes the project from the timeline and cost reports until it is completed again.
deleteBody: Delete "{{title}}" with its parts list and attachments?

filters.search: Search titles, fault codes, part numbers, or tags:abs
filters.tagsHint: Shows projects that have all selected tags.
filters.searchHint: Add tags:brake-fluid,abs to show only projects with these tags, e.g. tags:brake-fluid weak braking.

priorities.title: Project priorities
priorities.intro: How urgent a project is. Projects are sorted by this order on the board and in the list; new projects get the default.
priorities.name: Name
priorities.defaultHint: Only one priority can be the default. Without one, new projects get no priority.
priorities.builtinHint: Clear the field or type "{{name}}" to use the translated name again.
priorities.label: Priority: {{name}}
priorities.deleteDefault: This is the default for new projects. Afterwards, new projects get no priority until you choose another default.

tags.title: Project tags
tags.intro: Free-form labels for projects, such as type, subsystem or manufacturer. Tags are added on a project; here you can rename or delete them.
tags.empty: No tags yet. Add tags when you create or edit a project.
tags.name: Tag
tags.renameHint: The new name applies to every project with this tag.
tags.deleteBody_one: Remove this tag from its project?
tags.deleteBody_other: Remove this tag from its {{count}} projects?
